title: Tomo Doc Frontmatter
description: Schema for the 'tomo:' frontmatter block written by every Tomo producer. Validated at write-time in dev mode (TOMO_SCHEMA_STRICT=1). The root object is the full frontmatter dict; the 'tomo' property holds the lifecycle block.

doc_type.description: Type of Tomo-produced doc. Determines which state values are valid.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Valid values are constrained per doc_type via oneOf branches.

run_id.description: Run-id that produced or last updated this doc. Format: YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<hash>.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last write. Auto-set by build_tomo_block().

checksum.description: SHA-256 of document body at processing time

sources.description: Source documents feeding this instructions doc

oneOf.description: source — inbox items captured at Pass-1 dispatch
suggestions-fan — XDD-012 Force-Atomic-Resolve companion; same lifecycle as suggestions
instructions — Pass-2 / MOC-consumption output; applied when Hashi is done
rendered-note — Pass-2 rendered atomic note or MOC staged in the inbox, pending move_note/create_moc apply by Hashi (which strips this block). Marks the note so triage skips it as a fresh source.
garden-audit — /garden-audit scan output; the 4th peer upstream doc-type (ADR-1). Accepted after the user approves fixable findings and runs /inbox.
